shots.purpose: Introduce Fuzzby for the first time -- zooming in and out erratically while clipping flowers and singing his own chaos-chant, until a botched somersault spirals into a genuinely spectacular tumbling pass he never intended, and he claims full, undeserved credit for it.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby's flight has no fixed heading -- he darts, overshoots, corrects, all while singing. Each flower clip is a real physical event: his body catches the stem, pollen bursts, he barely registers it and keeps singing. The somersault attempt is a genuine loss of control, not a stunt he's aiming for -- his own momentum carries him from one flower-bounce into the next, faster each time, until one violent bounce launches him into the air and his tumbling body, entirely out of his own control, executes the double backflip and triple twist. He plants down hard, upright, by pure luck -- his own landing surprises him as much as it would surprise anyone watching. The beat between confusion and pride is the whole joke: he genuinely doesn't know what just happened, and then decides he meant it all along.

shots.openingPose: Bee-height flower corridor. Fuzzby already zig-zagging unpredictably between towering stems, no fixed heading. Zenny is deeper in frame, level and still, working her own flower, entirely unbothered by him.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting out here is stronger than holding on Fuzzby's pose because the next beat needs a hard reset into his very next overreach -- lingering would over-reward a joke that already landed.

One violent bounce flings him upward and, purely by accident, his tumbling body executes a double backflip combined with three full twists in the air -- clean and fast, entirely unintentional -- before he plants down hard, upright, by pure luck.

Fuzzby looks around, dazed, processing what just happened -- then realization curdles into pride: chest out, superhero pose, delivering his line with total, undeserved confidence. Zenny shakes her head and returns to her pollen, unimpressed.
